title: Minimal playable experience
prompt: This is an empty Roblox project. Make it a minimal playable experience: a large anchored baseplate Part named "Baseplate" (at least 100 x 100 studs, its top surface at about Y = 0), a SpawnLocation on it, and a server script that prints "Game ready" when the server starts. Players must spawn and stand on the baseplate. Verify it works in a running game.
